name: salesforce-agent-skills
description: Salesforce Flow skill for AI coding agents: builds and audits Flows with current elements instead of loop-and-decision patterns, with deploy-verified metadata examples and a checker.

interface.longDescription: Maps every Flow requirement to its current element, writes metadata from deploy-verified examples, and checks it for legacy patterns and deploy-time errors. Audits existing Flows with ranked findings and a migration plan. Deploy-validates when the Salesforce CLI is authenticated, and writes build specs without org access.
defaultPrompt: Audit this Flow for legacy patterns
Build a record-triggered Flow for renewal reminders
Review my Flow XML before I deploy it
